decisions.reason: The Opex assumption change does not alter capex values or shared-program capex treatment; the separate capex clause in the same message is already represented.
Applying the corrected Opex range to the complete network does not change the eight-site configuration or site-list source.
The source changes an operating-cost assumption, not revenue streams, pricing assumptions, or revenue documentation.
The corrected Opex input may affect calculated financing outputs but does not change the required capital structure, rate, tranche treatment, or refinement trigger.
The Opex source decision does not change the required Canadian tax or CCA methodology; the tax clause in the same message is independently represented.
The revised Opex input may change the calculated payment amount, but it does not change the sizing criteria or DSCR and equity-IRR thresholds.
Selecting the original brief's Opex range does not alter the model currency or 2026 price base year.
The Opex-specific source selection is already retained by the source Requirement and does not change the general obligation to annotate assumptions and their sources.
The corrected Opex assumption affects scenario calculations but does not change the required user-funded and PPP scenario definitions or comparison objective.
The source resolves one Opex-data conflict without changing the broader requirement to verify source data or the general roles of the project brief, attachments, and demand analysis.
Opex remains a required sensitivity variable; changing its base-case range does not alter the sensitivity-variable inventory.
The Opex assumption change does not alter the required three-statement structure or financial-engine basis.
